assessments.reasoning: The directly inspected primary publication identifies IBM in its cover, imprint or signature material. Fresh complete PDF SHA-256 5cee8dbe91499b0bdb203a7dfc1725d992588931764ae5521f72e155dc1bdcb5 matched the retained bytes and the rendered pages. The cited passage lies at Chapter 1, What the SAA Solution Is, printed p. 1 (physical PDF p. 27), and Chapter 8, Using REXX in different address spaces, printed p. 187 (physical PDF p. 213). IBM’s z/OS 2.5 reference identifies TSO/E REXX as the z/OS implementation of SAA REXX. It describes keyword instructions and built-in functions as usable in TSO/E and non-TSO/E MVS address spaces, while availability of TSO/E external functions, commands, and services depends on the environment. The scope is the SA32-0972-50 description of IBM z/OS 2.5. A TSO/E environment can be created in a non-TSO/E address space using the documented environment service. The claim supplies no general compatibility conclusion. The manual distinguishes the SAA language subset from z/OS services and explicitly permits a created TSO/E environment. Availability cannot be determined by the address-space label alone.
